subject: Renewal request: double Dedicated pool to 16 GPUs and update monthly commit
messages:

To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Li <jamie.li@pegasus.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & capacity request: doubling Dedicated pool

Hi Soojin,

We’re approaching renewal for our Dedicated pool on Dec 1. Usage has been trending up — attached is last 12 months of usage (Pegasus_MonthlyUsage.csv) — and our product roadmap requires steady 2x throughput for inference-heavy features launching in Q1.

We’d like to talk about:
- Increasing our reserved capacity from 8 → 16 GPUs for the upcoming 12-month term
- Updating the monthly commit to reflect expected usage (we’re targeting a steady-state commit ~2.5x current)
- Throughput/warm-start guarantees during launch windows (we need clear ramp SLOs)

Can you share an initial commercial and activation plan? Our procurement and cloud teams will need timing and any changes to billing start dates.

Thanks,
Alex

High level:
- We can support a 8 → 16 GPU reserved pool upgrade for your Dec 1 term renewal.
- Monthly commit: we’ll propose a mid-tier uplift to match your forecast; Ben will provide pricing tiers and discounts.
- Throughput & ramp SLOs: we'll include a staged activation plan with pre-warm windows and a throughput guardrail for the first 6 weeks post-activation.

Requested next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll circulate a draft order form (attached) with the revised commit and proposed billing start date.
2) Ops/Eng sync — Marissa, can you add the rollout checklist and pre-warm ops notes?
3) Ben will share the commercial sheet and DocuSign link for approval.

I’ve attached Draft_OrderForm_Pegasus.docx showing the proposed term, commit, and activation milestones. If OK, we can lock commercial and route to your procurement.

Looping in ops details and a phased activation checklist — keeping it pragmatic so Pegasus can launch without an operations gap.

Phased activation (recommended):
- Week -2: Reserve capacity reservation and control-plane config; billing hold until go-live date.
- Week -1: Staged pre-warm (20% traffic directed) to populate KV caches and warm kernels.
- Day 0: Full cutover to 16 GPUs; 72-hour elevated monitoring window.
- Weeks 1–6: Throughput SLO at 90% of target; automatic fallback to 8 GPUs with traffic shaping if errors exceed threshold.

Operational items to confirm with Pegasus:
- Exact traffic ramp percentages per day (Alex pls confirm)
- Model variants and sequence length distribution (to size batching/latency)
- Contact for 24/7 on-call during cutover (we recommend a Redwood-CS engineer + your oncall)

I’ve also attached an activation timeline PDF for your procurement to include. We can slide billing start date to the actual cutover if that helps procurement with PO timing.

Marissa
